svg.title: Megumi Kijo — Hearth of the Hag. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Megumi Kijo classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Hagmother's Welcome forks into Teeth Behind the Smile then Appetite of Oblivion, or Numbing Lullaby then Cradle of the Kijo. Mountain Hag's Mercy forks into Nursed by Demon Hands then The Ever-Lit Hearth. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Megumi Kijo-classified jutsu (requires classification extension).

Hagmother's Welcome answers \"How do I deal with my guest: lull it harmless, or eat it?\": Numbing Lullaby and Cradle of the Kijo take Phantom Realm Oblivion's single Decrease Damage Given row 30 \u2192 40% (Suppression), the kit's only supported damage-reduction row against its standing 10% Increase Damage Taken passive, and Teeth Behind the Smile and Appetite of Oblivion add +1 Damage each to both Genjutsu attacks (steady edge, no tier crossed). Mountain Hag's Mercy answers \"How do I mend the hag and everyone at her hearth?\": Nursed by Demon Hands and The Ever-Lit Hearth raise Benevolence's Increase Heal field to 40% for the caster and allies standing in it. Benevolence's 35% absorb also mitigates but is unsupported, as is its move row. BUFF","adverse":false,"base":1.0,"gain":0,"final":1.0,"calculation":"static","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["The Ever-Lit Hearth"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has four supported tags on five rows (Damage x2, Decrease Damage Given x1, Heal x1, Increase Heal x1). The enemy-facing Hagmother's Welcome forks into Suppression and the steady-edge Damage chain; the self-facing Mountain Hag's Mercy is a single chain onto Benevolence's field. A fourth capstone would be filler: Heal is one static tick (+10 HP per +1% once per 7 rounds), and a second Decrease Damage Given or Increase Heal route would repeat Suppression or the Hearth on the same row. Hagmother's Welcome is a universal node (in all 8 legal 4-BP builds) because Mercy roots a single 3-node chain.","design_notes":["Rewire (2026-10-04 batch, final pass): Teeth Behind the Smile returns under Hagmother's Welcome, as in the pre-batch tree, as a +1 Damage commit, and Appetite of Oblivion drops to +1 (route +2: Phantom Realm Oblivion 40 \u2192 42, Onibaba's Laughter 45 \u2192 47; the pre-batch +2/+3 lifted them 40 \u2192 45 and 45 \u2192 50). The earlier pass hung the chain under Mountain Hag's Mercy behind a +3% Heal step (+30 HP once per 7-round cast) that gated the Damage without setting it up, and Mercy's sustain sentence did not cover a Damage child. Under Welcome both children act on the guest (lull it or eat it), the dossier's two traits, Control and Sustained Damage.","Why a +1 Damage commit (steady edge, not burst): the kit has no Increase Damage Given or Taken row to set Damage up, a Decrease Damage Given step would twin Numbing Lullaby (a legal fourth for this route), and Heal or Increase Heal would be glue. No row is above 45, so no Damage result reaches the Nuke tier.","Values: Suppression stays 2/3/5 (30 \u2192 40%) without the pre-batch Cradle +2% Heal rider. The Ever-Lit Hearth is +5% Increase Heal (route 30 \u2192 40%), so each capstone carries one effect and Heal is Mountain Hag's Mercy's +2% alone. Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2, Decrease Damage Given +10%, Increase Heal +10%, Heal +2%.","Delivery: all cooldown 7. Phantom Realm Oblivion (single target, 60 AP) lands its hit and 2-round suppression together. Onibaba's Laughter (radius-1 circle, 60 AP) hits each enemy inside; its self Heal ticks once the next round. Kijo's Benevolence (40 AP) lays a FRIENDLY Increase Heal field within 4 tiles, then moves the caster, who gets it from the next round while standing in it. The bloodline's Genjutsu Increase Damage Given passive multiplies both attacks last.","Fourth purchases: Appetite \u2192 Numbing Lullaby (suppression 35%) or Mountain Hag's Mercy (Laughter 420 HP, field 32%); Cradle \u2192 Mercy or Teeth Behind the Smile (+1 Damage: 41 / 46); Hearth \u2192 Hagmother's Welcome only (suppression 32%). Only Appetite's route reaches +2 Damage."],"risks":["Classification: no kit row carries a non-None element, so the tree requires a classification extension: 'Megumi Kijo' is the placeholder name of a new jutsu classification assigned to jutsu records, not a bloodline-id selector; which jutsu carry it is a director/engine decision (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Targeting None instead would reach every non-elemental row in the game. Off-kit coverage is unverified.","Suppression at 40%: Phantom Realm Oblivion's Decrease Damage Given row has no element and lists all four stat types, so for 2 rounds it reduces every non-pierce hit the debuffed enemy deals to anyone. It is one target per 7-round cooldown, debuff-prevent gated, and compounds with other reductions as \u00d7(1 \u2212 p/100) in turn. It does not touch pierce.","Increase Heal: Benevolence's field is a FRIENDLY ground effect re-applied each round to whoever stands in it, allies included and never enemies (actions.ts 1006\u20131016, process.ts 321\u2013340; the dossier says self), and adjustHealGiven raises heal_hp, lifesteal_hp, vampRatio and absorb_hp for its holder (tags.ts 1110\u20131195), so 40% also lifts Benevolence's own 35% absorb and any healing in the window. A Laughter tick landing while the caster stands in a live field is raised too: the ground-derived buff copies the field's cleared isNew/castThisRound (process.ts 301, 333\u2013339) and heal adjusters run after heals (process.ts 440, 600), so the tick is 420 \u00d7 1.40 = 588 HP on a Hearth build, and nothing in the field's cast round. Lifesteal and vamp raised there still share the 60% leech budget, which is applied to the adjusted values when consequences resolve (process.ts 733\u2013766, 905\u2013917).","Heal timing: Laughter's Heal is one static tick on the following round (\u00d710 HP per point), deduplicated however many enemies the circle hits and blocked by healprevent, so Mountain Hag's Mercy's +2% Heal is +20 HP per cast once per 7 rounds.","Damage is formula-calculated and multiplied by the Genjutsu damage passive, so +2 EP is not a linear +2; Laughter's +2 applies per enemy in its circle (friendly fire ENEMIES, no ally hazard). The 10% damage-taken passive stays. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked modes. No combat simulation."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":8,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":3,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":4,"3":7,"4":8},"full_budget_allocations":8,"non_dominated_full_allocations":8,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"increaseheal":10,"heal":2},"supported_rows_in_kit":5,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagegiven":1,"heal":1,"increaseheal":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagegiven","heal","increaseheal"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Fable proposal \u2014 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Megumi Kijo classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).","Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Megumi Kijo-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.","Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.","Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."],"ceilings":{"maximum_over_all_legal_allocations":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"increaseheal":10,"heal":2},"ceilings":{"damage":5,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"increaseheal":10,"heal":10},"hard_ceilings":{"damage":5,"lifesteal":5,"afterburn":15},"default_ceiling":10,"route_bands":[5,10,15],"routes":[{"advanced_art":"03","name":"Appetite of Oblivion","primary_tag":"damage","path":["01","02","03"],"steps":[0,1,1],"total":2,"on_band":false},{"advanced_art":"05","name":"Cradle of the Kijo","primary_tag":"decreasedamagegiven","path":["01","04","05"],"steps":[2,3,5],"total":10,"on_band":true},{"advanced_art":"08","name":"The Ever-Lit Hearth","primary_tag":"increaseheal","path":["06","07","08"],"steps":[2,3,5],"total":10,"on_band":true}],"director_exceptions":[]}},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagegiven":5}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increaseheal":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"decreasedamagegiven":10}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"decreasedamagegiven":5,"increaseheal":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increaseheal":5,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"decreasedamagegiven":10,"increaseheal":2,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"decreasedamagegiven":5,"increaseheal":5,"heal":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increaseheal":10,"heal":2}}],"design_review":{"status":"Fable proposal (2026-10-04 batch rebalance); no tier crossed)","05":"suppression","08":"healing field for the caster and allies"},"director_review":"Roster questions: DQ-D (Teeth Behind the Smile carries +1 Damage as the commit before Appetite of Oblivion's +1; route +2, Phantom Realm Oblivion 40 \u2192 42, Onibaba's Laughter 45 \u2192 47).","concerns":["Appetite of Oblivion is the leanest payoff (+2 EP on two cooldown-7 attacks). +2 is the roster default for 40/45 EP rows (Arashima 45 \u2192 47) and the batch ceiling for flat Damage, so nothing larger is proposed.","Teeth Behind the Smile is a +1 Damage commit, not a setup (DQ-D): no percentage setup exists that neither twins Numbing Lullaby nor is Heal glue. As a result Appetite + Numbing Lullaby (01,02,03,04) and Cradle + Teeth (01,02,04,05) share three nodes and differ only in the capstone: +1 Damage (Oblivion 41 \u2192 42, Laughter 46 \u2192 47) against +5% Decrease Damage Given (35 \u2192 40%).","Cradle of the Kijo is single-tag (+5% Decrease Damage Given) where the director anchors' suppression capstones carry a rider; the kit's candidates are Heal (glue on a once-per-7-rounds tick), Increase Heal (the Hearth's identity) and Damage (an offensive rider), so none is added.","The Ever-Lit Hearth's 40% Increase Heal reaches allies in the field and Benevolence's own absorb, and lifts a Laughter tick taken in the field to 588 HP; it is positional and absent in the field's cast round (risks).","The 'Megumi Kijo' classification extension is a director/engine decision; off-kit coverage is unverified."]}}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
MEGUMI KIJO CLASSIFICATION · REQUIRES CLASSIFICATION EXTENSION
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Megumi Kijo-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Appetite of Oblivion path + Numbing Lullaby
Cradle of the Kijo path + Mountain Hag's Mercy
The Ever-Lit Hearth path + Hagmother's Welcome
DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IH: Increase Heal · HEAL: Heal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE MEGUMI KIJO KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
On a static Heal effect each +1% Heal adds 1 heal power, which heals 10 HP per tick (display conflict under review).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Megumi Kijo classification / forked tree
